name: print
need: Decide what goes on paper and where sheets break, and lay out a printable report or invoice

--ds-print-page-width.description: the width of the `.ds-print-page` sheet on screen (an A4 sheet)

--ds-print-page-pad.description: the margin of the `.ds-print-page` sheet on screen (paper keeps the browser's page margins)

important..ds-print-only: display: print-only content stays off screen whatever display a component or the page gives it, as the hidden attribute does
important..ds-print-hide: display: screen-only content stays off paper whatever display a component or the page gives it, as the hidden attribute does
